name: bge-small-code-search-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. A MultipleNegativesRankingLoss fine-tune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 on the CodeSearchNet Python subset (6,000 pairs, 3 epochs, 2e-5, batch 4, Apple M4) for asymmetric nl->code retrieval. Prints a base column and wins all three rows: NDCG@10 0.9849 vs 0.9761, Accuracy@1 0.960 vs 0.948, MRR@10 0.978 vs 0.975. READ THE CEILING rather than the delta: a 0.976 base NDCG@10 means the author's 500 held-out pairs are near-saturated, which is far above published CodeSearchNet retrieval numbers, so the +0.9% relative win says the fine-tune did not break an easy split - not that it generalises. No harness, seed or CI printed; MRR@10 +0.3% is noise-level. Licence Apache-2.0, repo created 2026-05-17. Confidence 0.35.
